calls.title: Forecast Mtg
calls.summary: The team discussed a positive sales forecast, with expectations rising to $725k, driven by new business momentum and pipeline quality. New business is projected to double from last quarter's $1.1 million, largely from new clients. Key pipelines were reviewed, showing bookings and potential upside, with significant deals under consideration. Account expansion strategies were highlighted, notably with HIMSS's growth from 50 to 419 seats. Competitive positioning was a key topic, addressing pricing strategies to mitigate churn risks with competitors like LaunchDarkly. The team also focused on improving forecast accuracy through better data management and collaboration.
calls.keywords: forecast, pipeline, proof of concept, build vs buy, feature flagging, FedRAMP compliance
